definitions: A carnivorous insect of the family Mantidae, known for its distinctive posture with forelegs held as if in prayer.
Any of various large, predatory insects of the order Mantodea, typically having a triangular head and prominent eyes.
examples: The praying mantis patiently waited for its prey.
A praying mantis can rotate its head almost 180 degrees.
We observed a praying mantis on the rose bush.
